title: Ridgepost Capital to Sponsor IPEM Global 2026
summary: Ridgepost Capital announced details regarding its sponsorship at IPEM Global 2026, taking place September 8–10 in Paris.
body_markdown:
DALLAS, Aug. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Ridgepost Capital, Inc. (“Ridgepost Capital”) (NYSE: RPC), a leading private markets solutions provider, today announced details regarding its sponsorship at IPEM Global 2026, taking place September 8–10 at the Palais des Congrès in Paris.


[Read the full press release.](https://ir.ridgepostcapital.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ridgepost-capital-sponsor-ipem-global-2026)
